title: Personal Checking: overdraft transfer fee charged at the wrong amount
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of the most recently posted overdraft protection transfer fee on a Personal Checking account. It concerns only the amount at which the fee was charged.

## Formal clause

The fee is a bank error when it was charged at an amount other than the checking tier's overdraft transfer fee. The comparison is between the amount actually posted for the fee and the overdraft transfer fee figure of the checking account's tier; the checking tier, not the savings account, supplies that figure.

## Condition table

| Posted fee amount compared with the checking tier's overdraft transfer fee | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|
| Equal | No bank error on this ground |
| Higher | Bank error |
| Lower | Bank error |

The clause says "an amount other than", so a fee posted below the tier's figure is also a bank error on this ground, not only one posted above it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical tier figures, chosen only for illustration)

- A hypothetical tier's overdraft transfer fee is 8.00 USD and the fee posted at 12.00 USD. The amount differs, so the fee is a bank error on this ground.
- The same tier, fee posted at exactly 8.00 USD: no bank error on this ground.
- A hypothetical tier whose overdraft transfer fee figure is 0.00 USD, and a transfer fee posted at 6.00 USD: the posted amount differs from the tier's figure, so the fee is a bank error on this ground.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "only an overcharge counts as the wrong amount". **Correct basis:** any amount other than the tier's figure counts.
- **Wrong reading:** "the savings account's terms set the transfer fee". **Correct basis:** the figure compared is the checking tier's overdraft transfer fee.
